entries.title: Exodus 35:1
segments: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the sons of Israel together and said to them, These [are] the words which the LORD has commanded, to do them.

entries.title: Exodus 35:2
segments: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does work in it shall be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 35:3
segments: You shall kindle no fire throughout your living places upon the Sabbath day.

entries.title: Exodus 35:4
segments: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel saying, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded. He said,

entries.title: Exodus 35:5
segments: Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever [is] of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD: gold, and silver, and bronze,

entries.title: Exodus 35:6
segments: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached [linen], and goats' [hair],

entries.title: Exodus 35:7
segments: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and acacia-wood,

entries.title: Exodus 35:8
segments: and oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

entries.title: Exodus 35:9
segments: and onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

entries.title: Exodus 35:10
segments: And every wise-hearted one among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

entries.title: Exodus 35:11
segments: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 35:12
segments: And make the ark and the staves of it, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the covering,

entries.title: Exodus 35:13
segments: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and showbread,

entries.title: Exodus 35:14
segments: also the lampstand for the light, and its vessels, and its lamp, with the oil for the light,

entries.title: Exodus 35:15
segments: and the incense altar, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging of the door at the entering in of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 35:16
segments: And make the altar of burnt offering, with its bronze grate, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,

entries.title: Exodus 35:17
segments: the hangings of the court, its pillars and their sockets, and the hanging, for the door of the court,

entries.title: Exodus 35:18
segments: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

entries.title: Exodus 35:19
segments: the woven garments to do service in the holy [place], the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

entries.title: Exodus 35:20
segments: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 35:21
segments: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom His spirit made willing. They brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all His service, and for the holy garments.

entries.title: Exodus 35:22
segments: And the men came in together with the women, as many as were willing-hearted, bringing bracelets and earrings, and rings and ornaments, all jewels of gold. And everyone who offered waved a wave offering of gold to the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 35:23
segments: And everyone [with] whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached [linen], and goats' [hair], and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

entries.title: Exodus 35:24
segments: Everyone lifting up an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD's offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia-wood for any work of the service, brought [it].

entries.title: Exodus 35:25
segments: And every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands. And they brought spun yarn, blue, and purple, scarlet, and bleached [linen].

entries.title: Exodus 35:26
segments: And all the women whose hearts were lifted up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

entries.title: Exodus 35:27
segments: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

entries.title: Exodus 35:28
segments: And they brought spice and oil, for the light and for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense.

entries.title: Exodus 35:29
segments: The sons of Israel brought a willing offering to the LORD, every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all kinds of work which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 35:30
segments: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, See, the LORD has called the son of Uri the son of Hur, by the name Bezaleel, of the tribe of Judah.

entries.title: Exodus 35:31
segments: And He has filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of work,

entries.title: Exodus 35:32
segments: and to devise designs, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

entries.title: Exodus 35:33
segments: and in the cutting of stones to set, and in carving of wood, to make any kind of skillful work.

entries.title: Exodus 35:34
segments: And He has put in his heart that he may teach, he and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

entries.title: Exodus 35:35
segments: He has filled them [with] wisdom of heart to work all kinds of work; of the smith, and of the skillful worker, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in bleached [linen], and of the weaver, of those who do any work, and of those who work out artful work.
